name: Santa Cruz de los Cáñamos (Spain)
description: Vertically divided green and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santa Cruz de los Cáñamos (a cross of Saint James, hemp leaves and a castle).
history: Municipal flag of Santa Cruz de los Cáñamos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Santa Cruz de los Cáñamos arms — cross of Saint James, hemp leaves and castle
